import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the films table
table = pxt.get_table('films')

# Filter for year > 1990, project title and revenue columns, and materialize
results = table.where(table.year > 1990).select(table.title, table.revenue).collect()

# Print the materialized results
for row in results:
    print(row)
